data_source: ESA-ADB / ESA Mission1 official preprocessed CSV
event_splits: chronological; at least two independent true anomalies in train, val and test; no window crosses partition
model_selection: validation point AP only, three fixed baselines
test_policy: once-only confirmatory holdout; diagnostic scores cannot change selection
state_policy: same labels Proxy-V1 in archived V1.2; no real faults; grouped MSF + calibration tools only until sufficient independent state events
telemanom_esa: not implemented in v1.3; official Docker needed
